about: The load page names the map a save was made on. The harness seeds the worker's own save slots (never the player's): slot 1 on harness_map (label = its map_button label), slot 2 in the village (no label), slot 3 on a map whose mod is not installed (label = the raw map id). The scenario opens the real load page and checks each slot's label.

steps.label: gone_map
steps.why: mod not installed: the raw map id
